name: acm
description: Certificate Manager You can use Certificate Manager (ACM) to manage SSL/TLS certificates for your Amazon Web Services-based websites and applications.

subcommands.name: add-tags-to-certificate
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tags to an ACM certificate.

subcommands.name: create-acme-domain-validation
subcommands.description: Creates a domain validation for an ACME endpoint.

subcommands.name: create-acme-endpoint
subcommands.description: Creates an ACME endpoint, which is a managed ACME server with a unique endpoint URL.

subcommands.name: create-acme-external-account-binding
subcommands.description: Creates an external account binding (EAB) for an ACME endpoint.

subcommands.name: delete-acme-domain-validation
subcommands.description: Deletes a domain validation.

subcommands.name: delete-acme-endpoint
subcommands.description: Deletes an ACME endpoint.

subcommands.name: delete-acme-external-account-binding
subcommands.description: Deletes an external account binding.

subcommands.name: delete-certificate
subcommands.description: Deletes a certificate and its associated private key.

subcommands.name: describe-acme-account
subcommands.description: Returns detailed metadata about the specified ACME account, including its status, public key thumbprint, and associated external account binding.

subcommands.name: describe-acme-domain-validation
subcommands.description: Returns detailed metadata about the specified domain validation, including its status, domain scope, and DNS resource records required for validation.

subcommands.name: describe-acme-endpoint
subcommands.description: Returns detailed metadata about the specified ACME endpoint, including its status, URL, authorization behavior, and certificate authority configuration.

subcommands.name: describe-acme-external-account-binding
subcommands.description: Returns detailed metadata about the specified external account binding, including the associated IAM role, expiration time, and usage history.

subcommands.name: describe-certificate
subcommands.description: Returns detailed metadata about the specified ACM certificate.

subcommands.name: export-certificate
subcommands.description: Exports a private certificate issued by a private certificate authority (CA) or a public certificate for use anywhere.

subcommands.name: get-account-configuration
subcommands.description: Returns the account configuration options associated with an Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: get-acme-external-account-binding-credentials
subcommands.description: Retrieves the key ID and MAC key credentials for an external account binding.

subcommands.name: get-certificate
subcommands.description: Retrieves a certificate and its certificate chain.

subcommands.name: import-certificate
subcommands.description: Imports a certificate into Certificate Manager (ACM) to use with services that are integrated with ACM.

subcommands.name: list-acme-accounts
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of ACME accounts registered with the specified ACME endpoint.

subcommands.name: list-acme-domain-validations
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of domain validations for the specified ACME endpoint.

subcommands.name: list-acme-endpoints
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of ACME endpoints in your account.

subcommands.name: list-acme-external-account-bindings
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of external account bindings for the specified ACME endpoint.

subcommands.name: list-certificates
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of certificate ARNs and domain names.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-certificate
subcommands.description: Lists the tags that have been applied to the ACM certificate.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags associated with an ACM resource.

subcommands.name: put-account-configuration
subcommands.description: Adds or modifies account-level configurations in ACM.

subcommands.name: remove-tags-from-certificate
subcommands.description: Remove one or more tags from an ACM certificate.

subcommands.name: renew-certificate
subcommands.description: Renews an eligible ACM certificate.

subcommands.name: request-certificate
subcommands.description: Requests an ACM certificate for use with other Amazon Web Services services.

subcommands.name: resend-validation-email
subcommands.description: Resends the email that requests domain ownership validation.

subcommands.name: revoke-acme-account
subcommands.description: Revokes an ACME account, preventing it from requesting or revoking certificates.

subcommands.name: revoke-acme-external-account-binding
subcommands.description: Revokes an external account binding, preventing new ACME accounts from being registered using this binding.

subcommands.name: revoke-certificate
subcommands.description: Revokes a public ACM certificate.

subcommands.name: search-certificates
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of certificates matching search criteria.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tags to an ACM resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from an ACM resource.

subcommands.name: update-acme-domain-validation
subcommands.description: Updates the prevalidation configuration of an existing domain validation.

subcommands.name: update-acme-endpoint
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration of an existing ACME endpoint.

subcommands.name: update-certificate-options
subcommands.description: Updates a certificate.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: acme-domain-validation-deleted
subcommands.description: Wait until an ACME domain validation has been deleted.

subcommands.name: acme-domain-validation-validated
subcommands.description: Wait until an ACME domain validation reaches a terminal validation state.

subcommands.name: acme-endpoint-active
subcommands.description: Wait until an ACME endpoint has finished provisioning and is ACTIVE.

subcommands.name: acme-endpoint-deleted
subcommands.description: Wait until an ACME endpoint has been deleted.

subcommands.name: certificate-validated
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query Certificate.DomainValidationOptions[].ValidationStatus returns SUCCESS for all elements when polling with ``describe-certificate``.
